subject: Deployment path strawman & migration scenarios — post-demo recap
messages:
From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
To: Jared Cole <jared.cole@apexhealth.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 23 Aug 2025 14:10:00 -0700
Subject: Deployment path strawman & migration scenarios — post-demo recap

Hi Jared — thanks again for the demo today, really helpful to see the current Triton pipeline and the latency profile. I promised a short follow-up with a strawman we can use to align on next steps. Attaching a 1‑page sketch (redwood_deploy_strawman_v0.2.pdf).

TL;DR (strawman):
- Pilot: Redwood Dedicated (reserved pool) mirroring traffic from your on‑prem cluster for a 2‑week perf and correctness pilot.
- Production options after pilot:
  * Hosted API: fastest path if you can push non‑PHI traffic and accept our regional hosting options; best for quick time-to-value.
  * Dedicated: recommended if you need consistent throughput with predictable unit economics and isolation but still want Redwood-managed infra.
  * Private (VPC / on‑prem): for PHI workloads and strict audit/KMS requirements — customer-managed control plane + optional on‑prem package.

A few quick questions to help us size the pilot and recommend a migration plan:
1) Primary migration source — is it strictly your legacy GPU cluster (Triton) or are you also using 3rd‑party LLM APIs for some features?
2) Target latency SLO (p50/p95) and peak RPS for the pilot window.
3) Any non‑negotiable compliance items (HSM/KMS, specific SOC2 controls, data retention windows)?
4) Do you expect a steady steady traffic pattern or large batch/offline workloads in addition to online inference?

Suggested next steps if you’re aligned:
- Confirm pilot scope and start week (2 weeks preferred).
- Share a short security contact and HubSpot entry link so we can send the NDA/SoW and security questionnaire.

Thanks — I’ll loop in Karthik for the sizing and Jordan for the migration playbook once we have answers.

Best,
Irene Choi
Account Exec, Redwood Inference

Attachment: redwood_deploy_strawman_v0.2.pdf (PDF, 1 page)
From: Jared Cole <jared.cole@apexhealth.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 24 Aug 2025 10:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Deployment path strawman & migration scenarios — post-demo recap

Irene — thanks, this is super useful. A few clarifications from our side:
- Migration source: primary is our legacy GPU cluster running Triton (on‑prem). We also have small experiments calling OpenAI for some non‑PHI features, but the customer‑facing PHI flows are all on our cluster.
- Throughput: peak ~100 req/s for interactive API calls (95p latency target <200ms). We also have daily batch jobs ~5k requests for nightly processing (can be batched). Typical tokens per request ~120–180.
- Compliance: PHI scope is critical — we need KMS integration and audit logs retained for 7 years (legal mandate). HSM is preferred but not strictly mandatory for the pilot.
- Timeline: looking to start a pilot in early Sep (week of Sep 8) if we can get the legal and security pieces aligned quickly.

Pilot ask: We’d like a Dedicated pilot (reserved GPU pool) for the 2‑week perf run with the option to test VPC peering to mirror traffic from our cluster. Can Redwood support a mirrored traffic setup and preserve token logs in a separate secured bucket during the pilot?

Also: can you confirm what falls under the Private/on‑prem package vs the Private VPC option (we might consider Private for long‑term PHI workloads).

Thanks — Jared
Jared Cole
Director, Platform Engineering | Apex Health
---
From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
To: Jared Cole <jared.cole@apexhealth.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 25 Aug 2025 09:35:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Deployment path strawman & migration scenarios — post-demo recap

Jared — perfect, that gives us what we need to scope. Quick answers inline:
- Mirrored traffic: yes — Dedicated pilot + VPC peering works. We can mirror reads from your cluster into a dedicated pool without impacting production. Logs can be written to a customer‑owned S3/GCS bucket with enforced encryption and retention controls.
- KMS/HSM: Private (on‑prem) and Private VPC both support customer KMS (bring‑your‑own) integrations; HSM workflows are supported in the Private on‑prem package and can be evaluated for Dedicated in the pilot if needed.
- Retention: we can configure 7‑year audit retention for pilot artifacts in a customer bucket; we’ll need a short MSA addendum on retention & legal hold.

Recommended pilot next steps:
1) MOP: sign the pilot MOP (attached pilot_mop_outline.docx) — defines traffic mirror, success criteria (latency, correctness), and rollback plan.
2) Security questionnaire: we’ll send our standard security packet and SOC2 evidence; please route to your security contact.
3) Pricing: Karthik, can you prepare a 2‑week Dedicated pilot price and an outline for a post‑pilot Dedicated vs Private TCO?

If these look good, can you confirm a pilot start week (you suggested week of Sep 8)? We’ll provision the pool and schedule a technical deep‑dive.

Thanks — looping Karthik for pricing and Jordan for migration steps.

Best,
Irene
Account Exec, Redwood Inference

I'll confirm the pilot start week with Jared once we have pricing and the packet ready.

Thanks — Irene
